text: replacement percolator knob. This is NOT glass.  It is plastic.  But I was not able to find a glass replacement.  I haven't used it yet. description: This is NOT a universal part. ONLY fits Yosemite stovetop percolators with 0.86" (22mm) hole in lid. Does NOT fit other brands. Does NOT fit electric percolators. If you are unsure, please measure the hole in the lid. Univen plastic knob top and washer ring fits Farberware Yosemite stove top coffee percolators. Fits 8 cup and 12 cup Farberware stove top percolators model numbers 50124 and 47053. Does not fit electric percolators or stove top percolators manufactured before 1997. Knob is 1.5" (38mm) tall and 0.85" (21.5mm) shaft diameter. The hole in your lid should be close to 0.85" (21.5mm). Quality replacement part by Univen.
